content: This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific use. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last revised in May 2024.
